# Minns Water Sports (MWS Boats)

> Self-drive boat rental company in George Town, Great Exuma, The Bahamas. Rents Boston Whalers and Power Cats (17' to 26', 6 to 10 passengers) for day use inside Elizabeth Harbour. No boating licence needed; drivers must be 18+.

## Key facts
- Location: MWS office and dock, George Town, Exuma, Bahamas (next door to Sandpiper Boutique). Mail: P.O. Box EX 29020
- Hours: open daily 8:30 AM to 5 PM; closed Christmas Day. All boats must be back at the MWS dock by 5 PM; no overnight rentals.
- Rental area: Elizabeth Harbour only (about 7 x 1.5 miles), Lilly Cay to Man O War Cay, Stocking Island to Great Exuma/George Town.
- Every boat: Bimini top, anchor and line, dock lines, life jackets, oar; steering wheel with power trim and tilt; full tank at pick-up.
- No delivery: open the contract and pick up the boat at the MWS office.
- Snorkel gear is sold (adult and junior masks, fins, snorkels), not rented.

## Fleet
- 17' Boston Whaler, 70 hp, 6 passengers
- 19' Power Cat, single 115 hp, 6 passengers
- 20' Power Cat, 2 x 70 hp or 2 x 90 hp, 7 passengers
- 21' Boston Whaler, 2 x 90 hp, 8 passengers
- 22' Boston Whaler or Power Cat, 2 x 115 hp, 8 passengers
- 26' Power Cat, 2 x 115 hp, 10 passengers

## Daily rates (USD, consecutive days, plus fuel used and 12% VAT; valid until 19 Sep 2027)
- 17' Boston Whaler: $316 (1-2 days), $272 (3-6), $243 (7+); deposit $300
- 19' Power Cat/Whaler: $418, $360, $330; deposit $400
- 20' & 22' Power Cat/Whaler: $498, $450, $410; deposit $400
- 26' Power Cat: $607, $538, $483; deposit $400

## Policies
- Deposit charged to Visa or Mastercard at booking or walk-in; fuel is deducted on return and the rest refunded.
- Change or cancel with at least 3 days' notice; 15% cancellation fee; no-shows lose the deposit.
- Bad weather: rental can be deferred or cancelled before heading out.
